name: EPIC 215107204
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 7, 26.2 solar radii and 1.47 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 215107204 (K2 campaign 7): PARAM radius (solar radii) 26.175268 (16th-84th percentiles 24.073684-28.396221), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 215107204 (K2 campaign 7): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 8061.796875 (16th-84th percentiles 7584.0625-8574.0625), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 8,062 parsecs away, 26 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 1.47 solar masses and 26.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,428 K at its surface.
